description: This file implements the NeedMediaData class, which manages media data requests within the Rialto server component. It handles initialization with shared memory buffers, validation of media source types, and sending notifications to clients about media data needs.

classes.name: NeedMediaData
classes.description: A class responsible for managing media data requests, including initialization with shared memory buffers, validation, and notifying clients of media data needs.

methods.name: NeedMediaData
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the NeedMediaData object, setting up shared memory info and validation based on media source type and playback state.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a notification to the client that media data is needed, if the object is valid and the client is available.
